# Turning Point › Mystic Backlash

> Those who deal in magic may find themselves at the mercy of chaos. This oracle can supplement, or replace, the Pay the Price table when resolving the outcome of a failed ritual or other negative interaction with mystical forces. Use this oracle in dramatic moments, or to introduce an unexpected outcome triggered by a match.
>
> Datasworn `oracle_rollable:classic/turning_point/mystic_backlash` · 1d100

- [4] Your ritual has the opposite affect.
- [4] You are sapped of strength.
- [4] Your friend, ally, or companion is adversely affected.
- [4] You destroy an important object.
- [4] You inadvertently summon a horror.
- [4] You collapse, and drift into a troubled sleep.
- [4] You undergo a physical torment which leaves its mark upon you.
- [4] You hear ghostly voices whispering of dark portents.
- [4] You are lost in shadow, and find yourself in another place without memory of how you got there.
- [4] You alert someone or something to your presence.
- [4] You are not yourself, and act against a friend, ally, or companion.
- [4] You affect or damage your surroundings, causing a disturbance or potential harm.
- [4] You waste resources.
- [4] You suffer the loss of a sense for several hours.
- [4] You lose your connection to magic for a day or so, and cannot perform rituals.
- [4] Your ritual affects the target in an unexpected and problematic way.
- [4] Your ritual reveals a surprising and troubling truth.
- [4] You are tempted by dark powers.
- [4] You see a troubling vision of your future.
- [4] You can't perform this ritual again until you acquire an important component.
- [4] You develop a strange fear or compulsion.
- [4] Your ritual causes creatures to exhibit strange or aggressive behavior.
- [4] You are tormented by an apparition from your past.
- [4] You are wracked with sudden sickness.
- [4] Roll twice more on this table. Both results occur. If they are the same result, make it worse.
